A.description: decision head + scorer + type embeddings + top 8 of 28 encoder layers (+ final norm)

B.description: full fine-tuning (encoder + decision head + scorer + type embeddings)

decision_rules.config_choice: Compare A and B on val_eval only (KrunBench validation + val_hard + val_tools). Primary: mean of intent core accuracy (KrunBench val) and tool core accuracy (val_tools). Choose B only if it beats A by >= 0.5 pp on that mean; otherwise the cheaper A. Ties within 0.5 pp -> A.
decision_rules.abstention_score: Among the three scores (after per-family temperature), choose the one with the highest mean OOD AUROC over {KrunBench val intents, val_tools} on val_eval; if within 0.005, the lower mean AURC wins.
decision_rules.final_report: holdout_tools and KrunBench v0 test (incl. BFCL) are evaluated once for Laya and the chosen Krun One after the choices above are frozen in results/krun_one_decisions.json; nothing is tuned afterwards.

variant_config.description: full fine-tuning (encoder + decision head + scorer + type embeddings)
